newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan buys 47,000 tonnes of Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 47,000 tonnes of Australian wheat.

text.p: Pakistan overnight bought 282,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat and 47,000 tonnes of Australian wheat, a Pakistani embassy official confirmed.
The total was slightly different than U.S. exporters had reported early Wednesday. Exporters put the tonnage at 285,000 U.S. wheat and 50,000 tonnes Australian wheat.

Exporters said shipment was slated for May 20-June 10. Sellers included Louis Dreyfus selling 112,000 tonnes at approximately $167.25 to $172.80 a tonne, FOB, the embassy official said, speaking from his Washington D.C. office.

Pakistan bought 40,000 tonnes from Continental Grain in a range of around $169.79 to $173.84 a tonne, 15,000 tonnes from Kanematsu USA Inc, at $170.50 and from Colombia Grain, 10,000 tonnes at $172.26, the official said.
Other sellers included Cargill Inc, 20,000 tonnes at $171.39 to $173.59 and United Grain, 60,000 tonnes at $168.09 to $174.39 Other details were not available.
The embassy official confirmed the May 20-June 10 shipment date. ((Doris Frankel 312-983-7305))
